Runtime and Configuration

Local development

Use Python 3.12 or newer and uv from the backend/ directory:

uv sync --extra dev --extra aws
uv run alembic upgrade head
uv run ai4sbench-api

Run background jobs in a second terminal:

uv run ai4sbench-jobs

For local development, .env.example is the configuration reference. Use TBCP_ENVIRONMENT=development, a local SQLite database, and TBCP_EXECUTION_MODE=fake unless you intend to exercise EC2. Keep real secrets in the ignored local .env; never commit them.

Processes

Entry point Purpose
ai4sbench-api FastAPI HTTP application
ai4sbench-jobs Community and v1 background job orchestration
ai4sbench-worker Control-panel worker
ai4sbench-v2-jobs Harbor v2 queue runner

The scripts are declared in pyproject.toml. Inspect the corresponding src/ module for exact polling, retry, and shutdown behavior.

Configuration ownership

src/core/config.py defines settings and defaults; .env.example lists the operator-facing environment variable names. Local Compose setups pass environment through env_file. Use the AI review page for its service-specific secrets and workflow settings.

data/, .env, credentials, OAuth tokens, and local database files are operator state. They must stay out of public submodules and commits.

Production deployment

Production EC2 runs the API and job runners under systemd. After the parent PR is merged into main and CI passes, connect to the server and run its deployment entry point:

ssh ec2-user@3.237.65.103
sudo bash /opt/ai4sbench/deploy/deploy.sh <main-commit-sha>

The script lives in the parent repository's deploy/ directory and runs on EC2. Omitting the SHA selects the latest fetched origin/main; the script freezes the exact commit before changing the checkout. It checks checkout cleanliness and main ancestry, creates and validates an online SQLite snapshot, fast-forwards Git and pinned submodules, syncs changed locked dependencies, applies Alembic migrations, and restarts the API and job runners. The Harbor v2 runner is included when enabled or active.

deploy/verify.py then checks readiness, proposal/review API routes and published Dashboard/Website files through loopback and the public HTTPS URL. Public HTML checks allow Cloudflare's analytics and email protection rewriting.

Production commands load /etc/ai4sbench/control-panel.env as the service account. The database is /var/lib/ai4sbench/control-panel.sqlite3; the deployment log records the snapshot path and target commit under /var/lib/ai4sbench/deployments/. Failure stops the sequence and reports its stage. Inspect the log and snapshot before recovery; the script does not automatically restore the database or downgrade migrations.

See the EC2 runbook for the first-release bootstrap command, prerequisites and recovery details. Update the runbook and deploy/ together when the release procedure changes.

Docs development

MkDocs uses the same Read the Docs theme as the contributor documentation:

uv run mkdocs serve
uv run mkdocs build --strict

The config is mkdocs.yml; pages are in docs/. Draft material under docs/draft/ is excluded from the published site.
